name: Biperiden

overview.mechanism: Antagonizes muscarinic acetylcholine receptors; an M1-antagonist challenge has produced temporary cognitive impairment in controlled human studies [[BIP-COG]].
uses: Historically studied for neuroleptic-induced parkinsonism; verify current local indications and distinguish parkinsonism from other movement disorders [[BIP-PARK]].

evidence.title: Clinical evidence and limitations
evidence.intro: Study regimens are descriptions of research, not prescribing recommendations.

rows.intervention: Biperiden versus benzhexol (trihexyphenidyl) for neuroleptic-induced parkinsonism.
rows.findings: Both groups responded favorably; no significant difference in individual symptoms between treatments.
rows.limitations: Older study with limited abstract detail; no placebo comparison, contemporary comparative-effectiveness conclusion or treatment of every antipsychotic-associated movement disorder established.

rows.design: Randomized placebo-controlled three-way crossover; 12 healthy older adults.
rows.intervention: Two biperiden challenge regimens versus placebo.
rows.findings: The higher challenge impaired sustained attention, verbal memory and working-memory performance; effects were dose/concentration dependent and temporary.
rows.limitations: A pharmacology experiment, not a dementia-incidence study or therapeutic trial in Parkinson disease. It nevertheless directly demonstrates potential cognitive harm.

sources.citation: A comparison of biperiden hydrochloride (Akineton) and benzhexol (Artane) in the treatment of drug-induced Parkinsonism. PubMed PMID: 7418951.
Biperiden Challenge Model in Healthy Elderly as Proof-of-Pharmacology Tool: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial. PubMed PMID: 34021607.

draft_notes: Source-linked descriptive findings and safety information only. Current local product information, contraindications, formulation-specific dosing and renal schedules require verification.

revision_log.change: Added source-verified descriptive monograph, clinical evidence and safety limitations without unsupported dosing or inferred dialysis regimen.
revision_log.approved_by: W. G. M. Rivero, MD (delegated source-verification workflow; executed by Codex, 2026-11-25)

common: Controlled challenge data show temporary impairment of attention and memory; the small study does not quantify the frequency during routine long-term treatment [[BIP-COG]].

older: Healthy older adults experienced dose-related cognitive impairment in the challenge study; a therapeutic benefit must not be inferred from use as a research model [[BIP-COG]].
renal: The selected studies do not establish renal dose adjustment or dialysis use. Renal and peripheral anticholinergic precautions require product-specific verification [[BIP-PARK,BIP-COG]].
